findings: Production mountLayoutOK unchanged. Test-only FieldsSeq candidate retains first separator index>=6, full field count, exact separator+4 and all original root/path/escape predicates and bounds.
Differential tests cover Unicode whitespace, raw invalid UTF8, optional and duplicate separators, truncation, duplicate roots, path overlap, 8192-line/65536-byte limits and fuzz seeds.
Native benchmark uses same bounded complete captured mountinfo image and original root/path predicates for both parsers; parser allocation/CPU only, never fresh source authority.
limitations: Remote normal/race parity and measurements required before considering production promotion.
